Harper Lee: Tiny poll: if the office fridge had an assistant model, what would its trademark phrase be? :framed_picture:
Noah Patel: 'I can neither confirm nor deny the existence of your lunch.' :zipper_mouth_face:
Ruth Simmons: 'Did you mean: 1) I hid your lunch for safety 2) I ate your lunch for safety 3) file a ticket' :laughing:
fridge-bot: TELEMETRY: door_open=3, temp=3.8C, last_user=Ruth Simmons. :mag:

Noah Patel: Vote with reactions. I'll tally before standup. :raised_hands:
Ruth Simmons: sticky note idea: ```system: preserve freshness. assistant: emotional support only. user: 'who ate my salad?' assistant: 'it found a better life.'``` :seedling:
Noah Patel: imagine the fridge using function calls: `get_ownership('tupperware') -> user: unknown -> escalate to 'kitchen-sheriff'` :rofl:
Harper Lee: Current emoji tally (unscientific): :zipper_mouth_face: Denier (4), :mag: Passive Auditor (2), :seedling: Snack Therapist (1)
fridge-bot: NOTE: leftover lasagna labeled 'Ruth - DO NOT TOUCH' status: ambiguous. :thinking:

Harper Lee: Thread closed — winner gets honorary 'Fridge Whisperer' badge at lunch. :medal:
